label: Town of Plymouth
header:
# Town of Plymouth municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 18; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term

Town of Plymouth, 'Local Results - March 3, 2026', the official return of votes for the March 3, 2026 local election, certified by Town Clerk Angela Kissell (173 ballots counted), as published on the town website: Town Moderator, one year -- Thomas W. Harris 152 votes

Town of Plymouth, 'Local Results - March 3, 2026', the official return of votes for the March 3, 2026 local election, certified by Town Clerk Angela Kissell (173 ballots counted), as published on the town website: Selectperson, three years -- Jay Kullman 155 votes

Town of Plymouth, Elected Town Officials page (plymouthvt.org): lists the Selectmen as Jay Kullman (Chair, term expiring 2026), Rick Kaminski (2028), and KT Cappellini (2027). The 2026 warning is signed Jay Kullman, Chairman; Richard Kaminski, Vice-Chair; and Keith Cappellini, and the town homepage names the board as Keith Cappellini, Rick Kaminski, and Jay Kullman; the fuller signature forms are used for the person records
Town of Plymouth, Warnings page (plymouthvt.org): the 2026 annual town meeting warning (signed January 20, 2026) warned the March 2, 2026 meeting, with Australian ballot polls on March 3, 2026

Town of Plymouth, Town Officers / Appointments page (plymouthvt.org): lists 'Town Clerk & Treasurer: Angela Kissell' among the town's appointed/hired officers; no clerk appears in the town's elected-officials table and no clerk race was warned in 2026, so she holds the office by appointment
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Angela Kissell as Plymouth's Town Clerk

Town of Plymouth, Town Officers / Appointments page (plymouthvt.org): lists the combined 'Town Clerk & Treasurer' office, held by Angela Kissell, among the appointed/hired officers; the January 2026 Guide's treasurer, Cherry Nicoll, no longer holds the office

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Cherry Nicoll as Plymouth's Town Treasurer (January 2026); superseded by the town's current officers page

Town of Plymouth, Elected Town Officials page (plymouthvt.org): lists First Constable Stephanie Seavy (term to 2026)

Town of Plymouth, 'Local Results - March 3, 2026', the official return of votes for the March 3, 2026 local election, certified by Town Clerk Angela Kissell (173 ballots counted), as published on the town website: Second Constable, two years -- Josh Linton 135 votes. The town's elected-officials table omits the Second Constable, but the 2026 warning warned 'Constables' and the certified return elects one, so the post is created

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Plymouth justices of the peace: Steven Radonis, Karen Evans, Richard Olmstead, Chase Morsey III, and Shawn Bemis. The town's elected-officials table names a different five (Bruce Pauley, Chase Morsey, Karen Evans, Justus Pingree, and Mary Morsey) -- an equal-count name-swap, so the certified listing governs and the town-only names are held
